page2_groups.title: A
questions: 在台湾，新年我们要放鞭炮。

page4_questions.en: Which weekday is Chinese New Year next week?

page4_questions.q: 那天大文要跟爸爸去给谁拜年？
page4_questions.en: Who will Dawen and his dad greet for the New Year?
Who will give Dawen a red envelope?

page4_questions.q: 大文的爸爸说在台湾还会做什么？
page4_questions.en: What would they also do in Taiwan?

page7_charRows.en: Dad said that next Friday is New Year.
Grandpa gives me a red envelope every year.

page7_charRows.post: 在台湾，新年 放鞭炮。
page7_charRows.en: If we were in Taiwan, we would set off firecrackers for New Year.

page8_fillGroups.name: A
rows: 张莉生日的时候，她妈妈

page9_trueFalse: 妈妈会到超级市场买年糕。
Mom will buy rice cakes at the supermarket.
新年的时候，大文的叔叔会跟大文家一起吃晚饭，可是姑姑不会。
Dawen’s uncle will eat with the family but his aunt will not.
大文的爷爷每年给他十个红包。
Grandpa gives Dawen ten red envelopes each year.
在台湾，新年的时候不贴春联。
In Taiwan, people do not put up spring couplets for New Year.
大文的爸爸说，台湾新年的时候会放鞭炮。
Dad says they set off firecrackers for New Year in Taiwan.
content.page9_passage: 下个星期五是新年，是大文最高兴的一天，那天可以吃妈妈在超市买的年糕，还可以吃很多东西，叔叔和姑姑也会在一起吃晚饭。大文跟文文会给爷爷奶奶拜年，爷爷每年都给大文一个红包。大文也要给叔叔和姑姑拜年，叔叔和姑姑也会给他红包。大文的爸爸说如果在台湾，新年的时候还会贴春联、放鞭炮。

lessonDialogue.speaker: 大文
lessonDialogue.zh: 老师说华人新年快到了。
lessonDialogue.pinyin: lǎo shī shuō huá rén xīn nián kuài dào le
lessonDialogue.en: The teacher said Chinese New Year is almost here.

lessonDialogue.speaker: 爸爸
lessonDialogue.zh: 对，下个星期五是华人新年。
lessonDialogue.pinyin: duì xià ge xīng qī wǔ shì huá rén xīn nián
lessonDialogue.en: Yes, next Friday is Chinese New Year.

lessonDialogue.speaker: 大文
lessonDialogue.zh: 妈妈会去超市买年糕吗？
lessonDialogue.pinyin: mā ma huì qù chāo shì mǎi nián gāo ma
lessonDialogue.en: Will Mom go to the supermarket to buy rice cakes?

lessonDialogue.speaker: 爸爸
lessonDialogue.zh: 会，那天我们还要给爷爷奶奶拜年。
lessonDialogue.pinyin: huì nà tiān wǒ men hái yào gěi yé ye nǎi nai bài nián
lessonDialogue.en: Yes. That day we will also pay New Year visits to Grandpa and Grandma.

lessonDialogue.speaker: 大文
lessonDialogue.zh: 太好了，爷爷每年都会给我红包。
lessonDialogue.pinyin: tài hǎo le yé ye měi nián dōu huì gěi wǒ hóng bāo
lessonDialogue.en: Great! Grandpa gives me a red envelope every year.

lessonDialogue.speaker: 爸爸
lessonDialogue.zh: 如果在台湾，我们还会贴春联、放鞭炮。
lessonDialogue.pinyin: rú guǒ zài tái wān wǒ men hái huì tiē chūn lián fàng biān pào
lessonDialogue.en: If we were in Taiwan, we would also put up spring couplets and set off firecrackers.
